richiami.difetto: In a fire the LPG may not exhaust from the tank effectively. Therefore there is risk of the LPG fuel tank exploding causing further risk to occupants and any other person near the scene.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected (Europa 1) and replace the affected valve with a modified type (Europa 2).
richiami.titolo: IN A COLLISION CORRECT EMISSION OF LPG GAS MAY NOT OCCUR
